candidate.description: Baseline memory-writing instructions checkpointed the exact IR-derived GPR write set plus RFLAGS at instruction entry. Inline read, write, and atomic resolver faults published their generated return PC after the architectural walker returned.
candidate.targetedVerification: A MAP_JIT read-succeeds/write-faults RMW regression proved the checkpoint restored the prior register/flags image, preserved the completed prefix, and left memory unchanged.
candidate.productionDisposition: Rejected and reverted because the targeted model was insufficient for the pinned workload.

disposition.reason: Write-only recovery reproduced the same deterministic init NX panic, while atomic-only recovery terminated the host runner with a native signal. The context checkpoint model therefore does not cover all externally visible state or handoff invariants.
disposition.remainingA05_4Work: Write and atomic resolver page faults remain on whole-block rollback. Further work requires tracing the exact production faulting host/guest instruction and all side effects, not a broader speculative checkpoint.
